name: Polaris
author: mstio
description: Never lose what you worked out with AI. Polaris turns your ChatGPT and Claude chats, meetings, mails and documents into a short memory you own: what is known, what was decided, what is still open. Every entry is sourced, facts are kept apart from claims and guesses, and it's plain Markdown any agent can read. This widget shows what's new and starts curation. Requires Polaris.

barWidget.description: Polaris: what's new, curation runs and health check
